title: Mitigation of Erosion in Wind Turbines Using Nanoparticles of Alumina
content: Nowadays the use of renewable energies is more common in our daily lives, since with this we counteract the greenhouse gases that are caused by the burning of fuels for the generation of electricity, horizontal axis wind turbines (HAWT) present a decrease in their performance due to the meteorological conditions present in their installation environment, whether due to the sun, rain, hail and dust, it has been observed that the area most affected by erosion is the leading edge of the middle of the blade towards the tip of the wind turbine blade.
